text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Look, look, Ku-chan-senpai, pretty, right?
Reminds me of flower crown Senpai gave me before—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what color flowers next time? 
I'll drop by florist again.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Senpai, you loved flowers, didn't you? Tiara races had lots in names too, right? Ahaha! ……Ah.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
……Good afternoon, Kraft-san. 
Look, whole team gathered today.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Fufuu! Special race happening very soon, after all!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Race preview special starts any moment. Let's get TV on!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Let's see, remote…… 
Pandora-san, seen it?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ……Yes, look at that dignified expression. Exactly right, carry yourself like true undefeated Triple Tiara winner.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Team <Ascella> produced girl like that…… 
Trainer's brilliance shines through, right, King-san♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Eh? W-well... yes. 
...They truly gave their all, including that blockheaded Trainer of yours.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh! But today's star isn't just her, is it? 
There are others... right?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It really... is quite a historic race. 
One never seen before.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Right? ...Hey, Ku-chan-senpai. 
It's about to start.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Seriously, today is soooo amaaaazing~, you know?
